name: Fan Card Carousel
description: Full-screen gradient stage with a deck of image cards fanned along a rotated arc. Scroll, drag, or click to bring a card to the front, with a trailing custom cursor.
contents: Stack of image cards, each with a large index number, title and photo
Two-part custom cursor ring and dot
behavior: Mouse wheel and drag or touch swipe move progress through the deck
Clicking a card jumps it to the front
Cards translate and rotate along an arc based on distance from the active card, with z-order and opacity fading
Custom cursor elements follow the pointer with eased lag on fine pointer devices
editableByProps: Number of cards, their index labels, titles and images
Wheel and drag sensitivity and direction

needsCodeEdit.change: Change card size or fan angle and spread
needsCodeEdit.where: carousel-item style block with clamp widths and the transform calc
cursor-node divs at the end of the component

needsCodeEdit.change: Change card overlay gradient or text styling

fixed: Listens to wheel, mouse and touch events on window and removes them on unmount
Renders a custom cursor fixed to the viewport on fine pointer devices
Root fills the full viewport height
